title: schema-unsupported refusal (DEC-0067)
description: What a receiver answers when a document names a protocol revision it does not accept: the revision received and the revisions it accepts of that protocol (all of them when the received value names none it can read). Sent before the document is read further; an HTTP route answers it as the JSON body of a 400, an MCP tool as structuredContent of an isError result, the same envelope as delegation-refusal.schema.json.

protocol.description: The revision the document named, as received (at most 80 characters); empty when it named none.
